pages.ld_description:
Classic toys from Fisher Price that every parent and grandparent will remember, re-released for a new generation to discover and enjoy.
Introduced in 1965, See 'N Say was the first talking toy that allowed children to pick the exact phrase they want to hear by pointing the arrow to an animal and pulling the string. The Farmer Says features 12 different animals and the sounds they make.
Suitable for age 18 months+
